description:
A team of girls who think big, work together, and aim beyond the ordinary. 

Our Goal:

Create a multisensory website where you can interact with buttons while learning how the Earth has changed over the years. Our site facilitates the understanding of NASA’s information about Earth, allowing anyone to experience these Earth's changes through interactive activities, visual resources, and easy-to-understand explanations, making learning about our planet more engaging, accessible, and fun.
